name: Bio Renegade
description: Can only be played if you have no Bio monsters in your trash.

name: Flower Boy
description: Grants +10 ATK to the monster on its right.

name: Reactive Bird
description: When moved: you can pay 10LP to move one of your monsters to an adjacent tile.

name: Shifting Sands
description: You can move one monster to an adjacent tile.

name: Dimensional Shift
description: When the Linked card is destroyed by card effect: you can move one card to an adjacent tile (up, down, left, or right).

name: Second Life
description: You cannot lose LP for the rest of this turn.

name: Participation Reward
description: If the Linked monster is destroyed by battle, you gain 5LP.

name: Party Crasher
description: When summoned: you can destroy 1 card.

name: Kidnetic
description: When summoned: you can move one of your cards to an adjacent tile (up, down, left, or right).

name: Metal Recycling
description: Pay 2LP: add 1 base monster from your trash to your hand.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: The Linked Monster can make 1 additional attack per turn.
